title: Hazelnut Salad with Croatian Twist
description: A unique salad recipe that combines the earthy flavors of hazelnut with the tangy taste of Croatian ingredients.

ingredients.name: Yellowed onion
ingredients.notes: soak in cold water for 30 minutes to remove bitterness

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together Croatian olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt, and black pepper.
In a large bowl, combine sliced yellowed onion and chopped hazelnuts.
Add the Croatian-style salad mix to the bowl and toss to combine.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
